findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "verify_place_claim" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "gym" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: update_place, answer_held_request, verify_place_claim, set_booking_notices, get_gym_billing_link, get_payout_setup_link, set_owner_email · Private data: claim_place · Public sink: check_place_in_ai, get_gym_report, update_place, publish_place, answer_held_request, claim_place, verify_place_claim, publish_gym_brain, set_booking_notices, get_payout_setup_link, set_owner_email · Destructive: cover_member.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: update_place, answer_held_request, verify_place_claim, set_booking_notices, get_gym_billing_link, get_payout_setup_link, set_owner_email · Private data: claim_place · Public sink: check_place_in_ai, get_gym_report, update_place, publish_place, answer_held_request, claim_place, verify_place_claim, publish_gym_brain, set_booking_notices, get_payout_setup_link, set_owner_email · Destructive: cover_member

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
